notes.title: Mod Racing Plans
notes.content:
For the last 10 years we’ve been quietly building 22 Racing Series, with the aim of not only creating the world’s first Real Time Strategy Racing game, but also the world’s first racing-optimised games engine capable of handling extreme speeds and track designs previously not feasible, AND to bring the community the most comprehensive and accessible game modding tools possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QOlspVH.gif[/img]

Our plan is to create a full suite of community creation tools, allowing players to get their hands directly on our tech and easily create their own tracks or even build their own racing game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lGfwZOa.gif[/img]
 
Whether you’re new to game modding looking for something that’s quick and easy to use, or seasoned developer after a higher level of access and fidelity, our suite of intuitive design tools are designed to make the process of modding as smooth and enjoyable as possible so that you can focus on creating.
[list]
[*]A Track Builder –  This will include a spline-based tool as well as a ‘snap-together’ interface for individual track pieces, allowing you to quickly and easily build fast flowing tracks, or anything you can imagine. From twisted tubes and 90-degree vertical inclines, to streamlined straights where you can fully appreciate the thrill of top speed plasma boosts.  [img]https://i.imgur.com/jmF9lhL.gif[/img]
[*]A Race Mod Tool – Tweak any aspect of our game, or create an entirely new one. You’ll be able to adjust anything from vehicle physics and lighting, to game mechanics and game modes to make the improvements you want to see to 22RS, or to build out your dream racer.
[/list] 

To give you a taste the games’ modding potential we’ll be shipping with two basic example mods already in the game, including:

A top down arcade racer based on the classic ‘Sprint 2’ from the 80’s 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uVaUMFI.gif[/img]
A Sim Racing mod based on current day vehicles at Bathurst's Mount Panorama Motor Raceway
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hCCK4j8.gif[/img]

Looking forward to giving more updates on our race modding plans as development continues, and in the meantime, if you have any race mod feature requests, then please feel free to let us know!

notes.title: PAX Australia update - v0.37
notes.content:
We've just recovered from showing the game at PAX Australia 2019. Thanks to everyone who visited us over the weekend and played the game. Congratulations to Asaema and Soterios who took out 1st and 2nd place in our competitive tournament, to take home an AMD Ryzen CPU and a SteelSeries Stratus Duo controller, respectively!

The version of the game that we were showing at PAX is now available on Steam for beta testers to play. I usually try to include a bit more of a development update along with these patch notes, but we have a big announcement coming next week, so I'll save the updates until then!

notes.title: 2019 Updates
notes.content:
So, it's been a while since we posted a development update here! Multiple game patches have been released (without posting any dev news) during January - April 2019, but these were mostly minor fixes and tweaks. As of the May and June updates, we're getting back into the swing of things with much more meaty change logs.

For May/0.34, we focused on game presentation, and explored some new UI styles. We're still experimenting and exploring UI options, but as a teaser, here's some of the "spectator mode" concept art that we commissioned from [url=https://vyxl.co/]Chris @ Vyxl[/url]:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/2ef8eb8ac70b3d64a44eaf7bc009f1446dc0052c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/3ed2823d0a841dac9359e19dcbcfe9495b777d02.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/5ff56313ea2803e1ba709370d204f7d96a7ca89b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/4f3c4753bababae4a1e6a6a023cb81f60649fa30.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/e9a1ee926bb39001cda56a37169ef518ecadd51f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/a556ca4fe43c586f0756af81f13e0c575161613c.png[/img][/url]

For June/0.35 we've tried to put a bit of polish on the sim-racing / VR-arcade experience. Force feedback is greatly improved, driving the Akuna with a steering wheel is more fun, the "Bathurst" event has been re-tuned, the controls HUD updates to reflect your actual input mappings, and the controls configuration is a little bit more streamlined.

[h1]Engine development[/h1]
The custom game engine behind 22, Revgen, is made up of several modular parts. The core graphics module, "GX" is in use by Big Ant Studios on the majority of their sports titles. At the start of this year, they asked for help to bring [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1028630/Cricket_19/]Cricket 19[/url] to the Nintendo Switch, so I've spent the first quater of this year porting Revgen's GX to the Switch, and optimizing the renderer for Cricket 19. 

22 is [i]not[/i] currently in development for the Switch, but it's nice to know that our engine is now capable of running on the Switch if that becomes part of our future plans :)

[h1]Phantasma[/h1]
https://medium.com/phantasticphantasma/phantasma-x-goati-entertainment-e5ba9af45283

Followers on social media might have noticed our partnership with Phantasma - a blockchain technology project. As well as using the Steam inventory service, we will be allowing players to choose to receive in-game cosmetic items on the Phantasma chain instead. These items will be tradable and marketable to other players directly, with no central authority controlling them. We hope to continue developing this partnership in the future to allow for other diverse ideas based on blockchain technology, such as tournaments funded by in-game currencies, incentivised community server hosting, post-race cheat detection, rewarding track creators, distributing mods, etc... Join us in discord if you'd like to chat about the possibilities of distributed in-game currencies.

[h1]eSports[/h1]
http://trade-media.com.au/news/read/goati-entertainment-receives-innovation-marketing-grant-creative-victoria/

Our plans have always been to refine 22's eSports capabilities with closed beta tournaments before the main, public launch. Our local government's "Creative Victoria" agency has decided to back this plan by providing funding for an eSports series (yet to be announced).

[h1]Battle Arena Melbourne[/h1]
https://www.facebook.com/22series/posts/1287639591389528

We showcased our game at BAM 2019, held another lap time tournament and gathered a lot of useful feedback. A big congrats to FC for taking out first place and taking home the AMD Ryzen CPU!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/34481b3437e88fa46e4a3cd7a79159dc79b57c2b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31067886/077ec6da8d267eee657243e3722345360dc3ed19.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Side projects[/h1]
As well as developing 22, we're using the same core game/engine to develop driver training software: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VTw7L5ouhy0 As this is all running on top of the same "platform" as 22, we're hoping that eventually 22's mod tools will allow the community to create any kind of driving/racing experience that they like, including realistic city driving such as this :)

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
We'll be exhibing 22 at PAX Australia at the end of October, so if you're in Melbourne, Australia, come by for another chance to win some prizes!

This update contains a recreation of a challenging real-world race track, for players who want to try out a strange blend of sim-racing and future-racing. The Bathurst track is still [b]extremely[/b] work-in-progress, so expect some bugs for now... 

Vehicle handling and physics have been re-tuned greatly in this update, with attention being paid to new players who haven't yet mastered the vehicle. Low-speed spins are much less likely, and steering authority during extreme high-speed manouvres is much improved.

As usual, all feedback is appreciated!

notes.content:
The September update brings a preview of the configurable vehicle loadout system. The vehicle editor doesn't yet allow you to edit your own loadouts, but within a race you can select from a list of pre-defined loadouts.

The previous vehicle loadout of 4 upgrade slots is currently named the "Hero" class, and is joined by 4 new classes designed to fill different roles within a team match.

Congratulations to 'Slipstream', who dominated the leaderboards during our time-trial open compition at the Melbourne Esports Open, and has won an Acer Aspire Nitro 5 gaming laptop, courtesy of AMD!

notes.title: July Updates
notes.content:
Version 0.29 is another small update, containing initial support for Windows Mixed Reality hardware, more work on the vehicle builder, and finally support for completely customizing your controls.

[b]Please note - the vehicle builder still does not save your creations[/b]
Another patch later this month will hopefully add saving, and the ability to take your creations into races.

We will also be posting a guide on how to set up custom controls for steering wheels, joysticks, etc, and would love any community contributions here. If you have a specific bit of hardware that you want us to support, let us know!

Improved replay cameras.

Support for Razor Hydra controllers.

As well as these regular progress updates, there has been a lot of behind the scenes progress on online multiplayer and vehicle editing systems, so expect to see these in a future update soon!

notes.title: March and April updates
notes.content:
[h1]March 2018[/h1]
Better AI after cars have finished a race.
New transparency rendering techniques.
Tire physics fixes.
New "Plasma" boost that slowly fills up from sector ownership.
Removed hand-brake button.
More consistent jump physics.
Tweaked vehicle aerodynamics.
Smoother vehicle steering.
Bunny hop ability (right thumb stick click).
Third person camera improvements.
Fixed UI on non 16:9 aspect ratio displays.
New sector upgrade mode.
New vehicle-position indicators, race-time, lap-time and leaderboard HUDs.
Hold reset to restart a lap (in some modes).
Disabled mouse steering (for now).
Race results and race notification improvements.

[h1]April 2018[/h1]
New track - "Coast".
Rebalanced audio levels.
Testing hybrid game mode with two win conditions - first to 5 laps, or to capture all sectors.
Support for Vive and Oculus controllers.
Draw 3D models of controllers when running in SteamVR mode.
Added (optional) motion/gesture steering controls.
Hide other vehicles in VR if they are too close to your camera.
VR UI fixes.
Added a steering wheel indicator to the VR HUD.
Settings->Attract Mode now ends.

To reset to the new default control scheme (mandatory for users of Oculus Touch / HTC Vive controllers), please open the Windows/Start menu -> Run, then paste [u]%appdata%\22 Racing Series\[/u] and press OK to open the folder where our config files are stored. Then delete the [u]controls.json[/u] file.
